description: Source code for a BitBucket prompt management integration with LiteLLM, including classes for prompt templates, prompt manager, and prompt management system, with methods for loading, rendering, parsing, and integrating prompts from BitBucket repositories.

classes.name: BitBucketPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template loaded from BitBucket, encapsulating prompt content and metadata.

classes.name: BitBucketTemplateManager
classes.description: Manages loading, rendering, and parsing of .prompt files from BitBucket repositories, supporting templating and metadata extraction.

classes.name: BitBucketPromptManagement
classes.description: Integrates BitBucket prompt templates into LiteLLM's prompt management system, providing methods for prompt retrieval, rendering, and prompt management workflows.

methods.name: _load_prompt_from_bitbucket
methods.description: Fetches a specific .prompt file from BitBucket and loads it into the prompt manager.

methods.name: _parse_prompt_file
methods.description: Parses the content of a .prompt file, extracting YAML frontmatter and template content.

methods.name: render_template
methods.description: Renders a prompt template with provided variables using Jinja2.

methods.name: get_prompt_template
methods.description: Retrieves and renders a prompt template, returning the rendered prompt and associated metadata.

methods.name: pre_call_hook
methods.description: Prepares messages and parameters before making an LLM call, parsing prompt content into message format.

methods.name: get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Provides a chat completion prompt based on the prompt template and context.

methods.name: async_get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Asynchronous version delegating to base class for chat prompt retrieval.

methods.name: _compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Compiles a prompt template into a PromptManagementClient, loading and rendering the prompt, and extracting metadata.

methods.name: async_compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Asynchronous version of prompt compilation, delegating to sync method.

methods.name: should_run_prompt_management
methods.description: Determines if prompt management should run based on prompt_id presence.
